messages.content: James wants to hang crepe-paper streamers from his backyard fence for his birthday party. His backyard fence is a rectangle that measures 20 feet on the long side and 15 feet on the short side. How many feet of crepe paper does James need to buy?

content.text:
# Solving James's Streamer Problem

I need to find the **perimeter** of the rectangular fence, since streamers hung around the entire fence would cover all four sides.

## Setting Up the Formula

The perimeter of a rectangle is:
$$P = 2(\text{length} + \text{width})$$

## Calculating

With length = 20 feet and width = 15 feet:

$$P = 2(20 + 15)$$
$$P = 2(35)$$
$$P = 70 \text{ feet}$$

## Answer

James needs to buy **70 feet** of crepe paper. 🎉
